timecoded_text_to_speech.text: Good day everyone, my name is Dr. Jeanine Wood and I'm the new Associate Administrator for Cooperative Extension at Virginia State University.
I'm a two-time North Carolina anti-state university Aggie and a University of Florida Gator, but I'm even more excited to be joining the VSU Trojan family.
I look forward to living in Virginia as I've lived in a few states throughout the US, Latin America and the Caribbean.
In addition to that, I'm super, super excited to be working with such great professionals with Cooperative Extension at VSU and I look forward to meeting all of you in the near future.
So look out Virginia, here comes Dr. Jeanine Wood.
